summary: Thomson Reuters Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching an Indenture and two Supplemental Indentures dated September 17, 2026, among itself as issuer, subsidiary guarantors, Computershare Trust Company of Canada as Canadian Trustee, and Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as U.S. Trustee. This is a routine debt capital-markets filing establishing a base indenture and supplements for future note issuances. No securities pricing, stake, premium, tender, acquisition, divestiture, or shareholder-activism terms are stated. No board recommendation, advisor, close date, or break fee appears. Arbitrage risk is not applicable; monitor future pricing supplements for actual issuance terms.
